listing.name: The Elder Scrolls Travels: Shadowkey / Shadowkey Remastered
listing.summary: The Elder Scrolls Travels: Shadowkey, remastered for Windows. A native PC port of the 2004 N-Gage RPG, rebuilt from the original binary, with widescreen, high frame rates, mouse look, gamepad support and LAN co-op. Bring your own game files.
